messages:
Katie: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few clarifications on the engineering org changes & hiring plan. I'll drop a short FAQ here; ask questions and we'll answer live.

Sam: Short update: no company-wide freeze. We're pausing some external hires in infra where we can reallocate internal headcount; product-facing roles and Dedicated capacity hires remain prioritized.

Maria: Timeline for reqs — for prioritized roles we're ramping interviews in the next 2–4 weeks, expect offers in ~6–8 weeks. Contractors-to-hire conversion conversations start next quarter. If you're hiring, please DM me the req id and hiring profile.

Raj: Quick color from platform: we're consolidating two infra squads into a single "platform-core" team to remove duplicate work on autoscaling & routing. This is about clarity and speed, not cutting throughput. Two TLs will rotate responsibilities over the next month.

Ethan: How will TL rotations affect the career ladder & IC promotions? Concerned about visibility for folks mid-cycle.

Sam: Good question. IC ladders remain intact. We'll publish a mapping doc and promotion rubric by end of this week. Most TL moves are lateral to unblock deliverables, not demotions.

Jeff: Ops note — SRE oncall headcount stays the same. We'll centralize some rotations into a shared rota between runtime & platform to reduce pager context switching. Playbook update inbound.

Katie: Org map + owners will be posted to Confluence today: https://redwood.company/confluence/org-mapping (placeholder). If you want to opt into the redeployment pool, DM Maria and she’ll flag you for expedited transfer.

Lina: Mobility/process note: internal transfers are being prioritized. Mark "internal" on the req form and Talent will fast-track interviews. Also, managers: please flag any at-risk contractors you want considered for conversion.

Ethan: Any changes to referral or hiring bonuses?

Maria: Referral program stays as-is for now. We may reprioritize payout timing for mission-critical roles; we'll announce any changes in the next hiring update.

Sam: TL;DR — no mass layoffs; targeted reshaping to reduce overlap and focus investment on Dedicated + product infra. We'll host office hours tomorrow 10:00am PT to answer questions. :calendar:

Ryan: Can we get a summary + recording for APAC folks who can't attend the office hours?

Katie: Yes — we'll publish a summary + recording after office hours and pin it in #all-hands.

Sam: Thanks everyone. If you have specific role questions, please add them here or email people-ops@redwood.company. (reaction: :thumbsup:)
